title: Bilingual PDF structured document
description: Topic-neutral paired-content input for scripts/bilingual_pdf.py. The calling agent supplies ordered texts and structure; this schema describes layout data, not translation or editorial requirements. Validate this schema plus the renderer's semantic, asset, font, compilation and layout checks. Defaults are annotations, not automatic insertion. Root/block extension fields remain permitted because the runtime ignores them.

$schema.description: Optional editor schema association. The renderer ignores this extension field; its type is intentionally not constrained here.

languages.description: Two supported profile IDs in physical left/right order. The same ID may be used twice. The zh-Hans/zh-Hant mixed pair is rejected because both map to one native language.

title.description: Two nonempty plain-text document titles in side order. No rich runs. The left title is the PDF title in bilingual/left mode, and the right title in right mode.

blocks.description: Nonempty ordered sequence of paired units. Order is preserved. No default.

language.description: Built-in language/font profile ID. The ordered pair defines physical left and right sides, independent of writing direction. he selects Hebrew; see references/languages.md. No default.

identifier.description: Stable block/link identifier; 1–80 characters, ASCII lowercase initial letter followed by lowercase letters, digits, dots or hyphens. No default.

plainText.description: Logical Unicode text containing at least one non-whitespace character. No default. Ordinary TeX metacharacters are escaped; newline and tab are permitted, but other C0 controls and U+202A–U+202E/U+2066–U+2069 bidi controls are forbidden. Supply separate blocks when starts must align independently.

directionalRun.description: One explicit direction run inside an RTL side. ltr is wrapped in native textenglish; rtl remains in the enclosing RTL language. Both fields are required and neither has a default.

text.description: Nonempty literal text for this run; no raw TeX and no embedded bidi controls.

direction.description: Direction boundary for this run. ltr isolates Latin letters, dates and numbers; rtl uses the enclosing side's RTL context.

richText.description: Explicit mixed-direction text for a side whose language profile is RTL (ar or he). Valid in a block caption, heading, paragraph, quote, reference, equation explanation, list item, or table header/body cell. Not valid in document titles. This object has no default.

runs.description: Nonempty ordered run sequence; concatenated without invented spacing, so include spaces in run text where needed.

textValue.description: One side's literal content. A string is always allowed; explicit directional runs are allowed only when this side uses an RTL profile.

imagePath.description: Case-sensitive relative local PNG/JPEG path under --asset-root, or the input file's parent when that option is absent. Starts with an ASCII letter/digit; extension is lowercase png/jpg/jpeg. No '..' path component, absolute path, URL, space or backslash. Existence, decoding and symlink containment are checked at export. No default.

image.description: One image path reused on both paired sides, or exactly two paths [left,right] for localized images. placement=shared requires a scalar. No default.

oneOf.description: Localized image paths in physical left/right order.

math.description: Shared, unnumbered LaTeX math expression, maximum 1,000 characters. Allowed commands: frac, sqrt, sum, prod, int, infty, alpha, beta, gamma, theta, sigma, mu, pi, Delta, times, cdot, pm, leq, geq, neq, approx, log, ln, exp, sin, cos, left, right, mathrm, mathbf, text, quad, qquad, overline, hat, bar. Only the documented ASCII math alphabet is accepted; no ^^ character-code escapes or backslash control symbols. No default. The validator is an allowlist, not a TeX syntax parser; compilation still checks syntax.

tableHeader.description: One side's nonempty header row, with 1–5 plain or explicitly directional cells. Rich directional cells require an RTL side. Its width must equal the other header and every body row.

tableRows.description: One side's nonempty body rows. Cells may use explicit directional runs on an RTL side. Both sides need equal row counts and each row must match the header width.

divider.description: Sparse central-rule overrides. Omitted members keep profile/package settings. Unknown keys are rejected.

enabled.description: Show the divider on paired body pages. Package default true; reading profile sets false. It is absent in selected-language output.

color.description: Six HTML hexadecimal digits, without #, used to define the native divider color. Omitted value remains native black!35; not an equivalent fixed RGB default.

width_pt.description: Positive rule thickness in points, at most 3. Package default 0.3 pt; ignored visually when divider is disabled.

style.description: One safe TikZ line-style name. Native TeX allows wider trusted styling, but JSON does not.

pageNumbers.description: Sparse folio overrides. A missing object preserves package/profile settings. Prefix and suffix are literal text, not TeX.

position.description: Named header/footer position or none. Outer/inner follow logical page parity in twoside layout. Package default footer-outer; reading profile footer-center.

numbering.description: Native page counter format; changing it uses pagenumbering and resets the logical page counter. gobble makes the printed number empty.

prefix.description: Literal text before the live page number. Empty by default; at most 80 Unicode characters and no C0 controls. Unlike content text, it may be blank and currently does not reject bidi-control characters.

suffix.description: Literal text after the live page number. Empty by default; at most 80 Unicode characters and no C0 controls. It may be blank.

layout.description: Optional data-only presentation overrides, applied after the selected profile. Omitted members retain package/profile values; schema default annotations do not insert values. Unknown keys are rejected.

profile.description: Initial presentation preset. article means no preset, not a native profile named article. bound changes only mirrored inner/outer/binding geometry; reading changes spacing, rule and folio. Explicit fields then override it.

paper.description: Paper size passed to geometry. Native TeX can additionally use custom dimensions.

twoside.description: Mirror inner/outer geometry and outer/inner furniture on alternating logical page numbers. Generated document defaults to twoside=true; this does not select languages or writing direction.

font_size.description: Body font size in points. Package default 9; reading profile default 11. When explicitly set without leading, export also sets leading to round(font_size × 1.2, 2).

leading.description: Body baseline spacing in points. Must be at least effective font_size. Package default 10.8, reading profile 14; explicit font_size without leading instead supplies 1.2 × that size. The schema cannot compare these values.

margin_mm.description: Set both inner and outer margins in mm; explicit inner_mm/outer_mm subsequently override the corresponding side. Omitted package default is 18 each; bound uses 24 inner/16 outer.

inner_mm.description: Inside text margin in mm before the additional binding offset. Overrides margin_mm on the inner side. Defaults: article/reading 18, bound 24.

outer_mm.description: Outside text margin in mm. Overrides margin_mm on the outer side. Defaults: article/reading 18, bound 16.

binding_mm.description: Additional binding allowance in mm passed as geometry bindingoffset. Defaults: article/reading 0, bound 3.

top_mm.description: Top text margin in mm, passed to geometry. Header placement also follows native head dimensions.

bottom_mm.description: Bottom text margin in mm, passed to geometry. Footer clearance also depends on native footskip.

gap_mm.description: Physical gap between equal paired columns in mm. Also configures selected-language standard column separation where applicable.

covers.description: Emit front and back cover helpers around the body. Defaults false. With native defaults they include a blank front verso and inside-back face and end on an even physical page.

paragraph_flow.description: Global paragraph pagination policy. keep uses bounded paired paragraphs; breakable uses flowing paragraphs that may cross pages. A paragraph block's flow overrides this. Lists/tables/figures remain governed by their own bounded-unit behavior.

block.description: One caller-supplied layout unit. id is required; text is required except for an uncaptioned table; omitted kind means paragraph. The runtime accepts and ignores unrecognized block fields, and kind-specific fields outside their kind; this schema intentionally preserves that compatibility. Prefer documented fields only. Cross-block ID/reference checks remain runtime checks.

id.description: Unique stable ID for this block and its anchor. pt-title is reserved; generated child IDs must not collide with any explicit ID.

kind.description: Layout operation for the unit. No content is generated or translated by selecting a kind.

text.description: Exactly two ordered sides. Non-list kinds use text values; list uses two nonempty item arrays of equal length. For tables/figures this is the caption; omit text for an uncaptioned table (provided captions remain nonempty); for equation it is the explanation; for reference it is link wording.

break_before.description: Emit clearpage before this unit. Omitted false. Applies to every kind; it is an explicit pagination request.

flow.description: Paragraph-only pagination override. keep is bounded; breakable flows across pages; atomic is a compatibility alias for keep. Omitted inherits layout.paragraph_flow (default keep), so no unconditional field default is inserted. Presence on non-paragraph kinds is rejected.

placement.description: Figure-only placement. paired places one image per column; shared prints a scalar image once across the text area with paired captions. Presence on any non-figure kind is rejected.

image.description: Required for figure; see image definition. Ignored on other kinds. No default.

headers.description: Required for table; two matching 1–5-cell plain-text header arrays. Ignored on other kinds. No default.

rows.description: Required for table; two nonempty row arrays with equal counts and matching header widths. Ignored on other kinds. No default.

math.description: Required for equation; a limited shared math expression. Ignored on other kinds. No default.

target.description: Required for reference; a stable identifier. Local references must name an explicit block ID. A reference with file retains a syntactically valid target but links using page. Ignored on other kinds.

file.description: Optional for reference: relative PDF path selecting a companion document. Allowed grammar permits at most one leading ../, then lowercase initial letter and lowercase letters/digits/slashes/underscores/hyphens, ending .pdf. No default; absent means local reference. Ignored on other kinds.

page.description: Required positive physical PDF page number when a reference includes file (1-based). The renderer uses it for the external link. Ignored without reference.file. Python additionally requires an actual int, not bool or float.

page_label.description: Optional nonempty plain printed folio for an external reference, e.g. iii. Defaults to the decimal page number for display; ignored without reference.file. Does not change the link destination.

caption_prefix.description: Figure-only generated label prefix. automatic preserves the localized figure number; none displays the exact supplied caption without a generated prefix. The figure counter and anchor remain.

chunks.description: Optional breakable paragraph fragments. Child text concatenates exactly to parent text on both sides, including boundary spaces; the runtime checks this and unique safe IDs. Paired output aligns child starts without new paragraph indentation/gaps. Selected output uses the joined parent text.

text.description: Exactly two nonempty item arrays; lengths must match (runtime semantic check).
Exactly two content values in left/right order.

headers.description: Two plain-text header arrays in side order.

rows.description: Two nonempty row collections in side order.

file.description: Relative companion-PDF path; a syntactic path restriction, not proof that the companion exists or is authorized.

page.description: 1-based physical PDF destination, not a printed folio.
